title: Relevance Assessment
description: Schema for reviewable profile-aware relevance metadata for regulatory and trade intelligence artifacts.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this relevance_assessment payload.

assessment_id.description: Stable identifier for this relevance assessment.

assessed_at.description: UTC timestamp when this relevance assessment was produced.

assessed_by.description: Reviewer, workflow, or local producer identifier for this assessment.

profile_ref.description: Reference to the broker_profile context used for this assessment.

artifact_ref.description: Reference to the reviewed artifact, delta, evidence report, source snapshot, or approved knowledge element being assessed.

country_scope.description: Country or regional codes explicitly covered by this relevance assessment.

jurisdiction_scope.description: Human-readable jurisdictions explicitly covered by this relevance assessment.

affected_codes.description: Affected nomenclature, tariff, or regulatory codes relevant to this assessment.

affected_commodities.description: Affected commodity labels relevant to this assessment.

affected_topics.description: Affected regulatory or operational topics relevant to this assessment.

profile_match.description: How closely the assessed artifact matches the referenced profile context.

relevance_level.description: Overall relevance level for the referenced profile context.

risk_level.description: Risk level associated with this relevance assessment.

urgency.description: Recommended urgency for review or monitoring.

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of why the artifact is or is not relevant to the referenced profile context.

requires_human_review.description: Whether this relevance assessment requires human review before downstream use.

review_status.description: Review state for this relevance assessment.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this assessment record was created.

source_refs.description: Optional source_version or local source references supporting this assessment. Raw source bodies are not embedded.

evidence_refs.description: Optional evidence artifact references supporting this assessment.

review_manifest_ref.description: Optional review_manifest reference associated with this assessment.

affected_specializations.description: Optional broker profile specializations affected by the assessed artifact.

recommended_actions.description: Optional human-reviewed recommended actions or checks.

uncertainty_notes.description: Optional uncertainty notes that preserve explainability and review context.

effective_date.description: Optional date when the assessed relevance becomes effective.

expires_at.description: Optional UTC timestamp when this assessment expires.

downstream_allowed.description: Optional flag indicating whether downstream consumption is allowed under the current review state.
